_comment: Review decisions for the GLFS subset, applied by bin/extract-glfs.py.
Same contract as recipes/review-overrides.json: drop / replace / enable / defer.
GLFS has no downloadable pre-built chunked HTML (unlike LFS/BLFS) -- pages are
fetched one at a time from linuxfromscratch.org's own view/<ver>/ path into
book/glfs-<ver>/ as each package needs one. Markup differs from LFS/BLFS in one
way, checked directly against real pages: GLFS marks an admonition with a bare
class (e.g. class="note") rather than "admon note", and marks root-only commands
with <pre class="root">, same as BLFS -- both handled by bin/booklib.py.

3.reason: Rebuilds libglvnd for 32-bit/multilib (--cross-file=lib32), a GLFS/MLFS prerequisite this project does not build for any host (no multilib toolchain -- GLFS's own multilib setup is out of scope, this project only takes individual GLFS pages as book sources for a plain 64-bit LFS/BLFS system). True of any non-multilib LFS box, not host-specific.

4.reason: Installs the 32-bit build from block 3, which is dropped.
